hydrologic_mask.rule: all hydrologic area integration must be clipped to this geometry

meteorological_acquisition.rule: download/search gauges and NWP over basin+buffer; clip hydrologic computation back to basin

station_policy.inside_basin: eligible for hydrologic observation/assimilation/calibration by variable/QC
station_policy.inside_buffer_outside_basin: eligible only for meteorological spatialization/context; never hydrologic contributing area

grid_policy.new_rule: every gridded field must carry inside_basin and inside_download_buffer masks; basin statistics use inside_basin cells/area weights only
